record.category: Polish multi-hoster debrid, prepaid traffic packages (white-label twin of Pobierz.biz)

free_tier.stated: None. Traffic packages only, from 10 GB at 6,99 zł.

per_object_cap.stated: not stated: a traffic balance, not a per-file cap

egress.terms: Prepaid gigabytes with no expiry and no speed cap: 'Bez limitu prędkości'.
egress.price_per_tb: PLN 31.99 per 100 GB; PLN 109.99 per 400 GB

record.interface_detail: Web form only; identical to Pobierz.biz's, with no API, CLI or protocol endpoint documented.
record.tooling: Browser only; no API and no download-manager plugin named.
record.chaining: Because it is the same product as Pobierz.biz, the only reason to use this domain is a working payment route or a working host when the other is down; it adds no host coverage.
record.limits_note: 64 supported hostings; no concurrency figure, no per-host daily cap, no fair-use paragraph.
record.binding_note: Same arithmetic as its twin: 1 TiB of monthly transfer is about PLN 276 of prepaid balance, and the balance is what stops the transfer.

identity_cost.detail: Account needed to hold the balance; login is behind a Cloudflare Turnstile widget. Signup fields not read.

record.reliability_note: Two brands on one build means an outage is likely to hit both; a prepaid balance is the exposure if the operator disappears.
record.confidence_note: Price ladder, host count and no-expiry term read from the vendor. The twin finding is a byte-level comparison of the two home pages, not a guess.

evidence.proved: the same six package prices as Pobierz.biz, 'Pobieranie z 64 hostingów', 'Transfer nie wygasa'
'Jedno konto - kilkadziesiąt hostingów' and the same three-step flow and host list as Pobierz.biz

after normalising the brand string the two documents differ in 57 diff lines, all of them the GA tag, the logo asset, the Trustpilot business-unit id, the Turnstile keys and the script filename routes.js vs routes_rt.js; the Google Ads conversion id AW-17061610643 is identical

record.price_per_tb_month: PLN 276 per TB (EUR 63.2 at the ECB reference rate 4.3695 of 2026-10-22)
record.notes: Polish traffic reseller sharing backend infrastructure and payment processing with Pobierz.biz.
